# grouper_subject (Data Source)

Looks up a person or other subject, failing if it doesn't exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "grouper_subject" "charlie" {
  id     = "charlie"
  source = "ldap"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Subject ID, such as `charlie`.
- `source` (String) Subject source, such as `ldap`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the subject, which depends on the source.
- `name` (String) Name of the subject, such as a person's full name.
